name: Adobe Developer Console client ID
description: The Client ID of an Adobe Developer Console credential, sent beside the client secret in token requests and as the x-api-key header and shown in the consent URL. The pages present it as the credential's identifier (the consent URL and the I/O Management API headers carry it openly) and the secret is a separate value; the pages state no shape for it beyond a sample list response. No sample is recorded.

sources.supports: client_id is the Client ID obtained from the Developer Console and is sent in the x-api-key header of the secrets API requests, separately from the client secret.
sources.locator: sections "Fetching access tokens" and "List all client secrets"

sources.supports: The consent URL carries client_id as a query parameter, described as the Client ID of the partner app from the credential overview page.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
